session.title: porotomo-is-single-light: Report the headline results of the agent

answer:
Headline results of run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (from `python3 ~/poro/agent/report.py <run>`, read-only; no PBS jobs submitted, hazard.py not run):

- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20, 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z, 3.314 % of time)
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57
- DAS detections: 62 in 53 records; relative b 0.9849 (34 above Mc)
- Pumping: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days
- Catalogue: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07 (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016)

CALIBRATED probability (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 — the LBNL/NCEDC catalogue is the calibrated one):
  b     Sigma     P(M>=5.5)/yr   P(M>=5.5) observed volume   P(M>=3)/yr
  1.0   -5.449    0.0001198      5.236e-06                   0.03719
  0.73  -5.319    0.004922       0.0002155                   0.2809
  0.65  -5.281    0.01474        0.0006484                   0.4653

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (uncalibrated magnitudes; every detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts):
  b 0.9849, Sigma -2.698, P(M>=5.5)/yr 0.07842

Interpretation: the calibrated LBNL-catalogue estimate of a Pohang-like Mw>=5.5 event is at most ~1.5e-2 per year (b=0.65 scenario; ~1.2e-4/yr at b=1.0), whereas the DAS-based upper bound is 0.07842/yr because DAS magnitudes are uncalibrated and the counting over-counts events.
